name: Your Thoughts
overview: Scripture reveals that our thoughts are deeply known and examined by the powerful Word of God, which discerns the intents of the heart with penetrating precision. Believers are called to present themselves wholly to God as a living sacrifice, which includes the discipline of controlling and aligning their thoughts with His truth. The Word serves as a guiding light, illuminating the path for our minds and helping us to walk in holiness and obedience.
